## 5 · Preflight and approval

::: {.ter-check-grid}
- [ ] Document and display units are mm
- [ ] Page size matches intended physical output
- [ ] Critical dimensions match the plan
- [ ] HOLE and CIRCLE PART intent is named
- [ ] Every intended cut path appears once
- [ ] No hidden or stray objects
- [ ] Text is handled according to local workflow
- [ ] CUT / SCORE / ENGRAVE are separated
- [ ] Small fit coupon was cut where needed
- [ ] Material, ventilation and fire-watch rules checked
- [ ] Mounting/load plan has teacher approval where required
- [ ] Machine preview matches the intended parts
:::

**Teacher / operator approval before fabrication:** ____________________ **Date/time:** ____________________
